title: Lagged commercial-bank business-loan year-over-year growth acceleration for BTC long or cash
thesis: A conservatively lagged monthly acceleration in U.S. commercial and industrial loan year-over-year growth may identify broadening business credit or demand with better subsequent Bitcoin risk-adjusted economics than nonaccelerating months.
mechanism: Using only the sealed present-vintage BUSLOANS monthly series, compute BUSLOANS_t divided by BUSLOANS_t-minus-12 minus one and subtract the immediately prior month's analogous year-over-year rate. Make the state usable on the first day of the second following month at 00:00 UTC. Hold full-capital unlevered BTC only when the adjacent year-over-year growth change is strictly positive, and zero-yield cash otherwise. No total loans, consumer loans, standards surveys, deposits, spreads, rates, absolute-growth level, magnitude threshold, smoothing, alternate lag, inverse direction or combined factor is allowed.
economic_rationale: If accelerating business-credit balances proxy broader credit availability or demand, the policy may avoid nonaccelerating drawdowns while retaining enough BTC upside to improve matched-capital Calmar after explicit normal and doubled friction. Because crisis credit-line draws and revisions can break the mechanism, Design, Validation, annual breadth, episode concentration and terminal inventory must all pass.
